text: For the Chief Musician; [set to] Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. We give thanks{H3034} unto thee, O God;{H430} We give thanks,{H3034} for thy name{H8034} is near:{H7138} Men tell{H5608} of thy wondrous works.{H6381}
When I shall find{H3947} the set{H4150} time, I will judge{H8199} uprightly.{H4339}
The earth{H776} and all the inhabitants{H3427} thereof are dissolved:{H4127} I have set up{H8505} the pillars{H5982} of it. {H5542}
I said{H559} unto the arrogant,{H1984} Deal not arrogantly;{H1984} And to the wicked,{H7563} Lift not up{H7311} the horn:{H7161}
Lift not up{H7311} your horn{H7161} on high;{H4791} Speak{H1696} not with a stiff{H6277} neck.{H6677}
For neither from the east,{H4161} nor from the west,{H4628} Nor yet from the south,{H4057} [cometh] lifting up.{H7311}
But God{H430} is the judge:{H8199} He putteth down{H8213} one, and lifteth up{H7311} another.

For in the hand{H3027} of Jehovah{H3068} there is a cup,{H3563} and the wine{H3196} foameth;{H2560} It is full{H4392} of mixture,{H4538} and he poureth out{H5064} of the same:{H2088} Surely the dregs{H8105} thereof, all the wicked{H7563} of the earth{H776} shall drain{H4680} them, and drink{H8354} them.
But I will declare{H5046} for ever,{H5769} I will sing praises{H2167} to the God{H430} of Jacob.{H3290}
All the horns{H7161} of the wicked{H7563} also will I cut off;{H1438} But the horns{H7161} of the righteous{H6662} shall be lifted up.{H7311}
